private theorem e_summable : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ n - 1)) :=

      1 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ m - 1) + ∑' k : ℕ, (1 : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + (m + 1)) - 1) := by
  rw [(tail_summable m).tsum_eq_zero_add]
  simp only [zero_add]
  congr 1
  apply tsum_congr

  rw [show k + 1 + m = k + (m + 1) by ring]

private theorem e_le_tail (m : ℕ) :
